_note: Transcription of the exact Railway Template Composer settings for the MongoDB 9.0 template. Railway does NOT read this file automatically — enter these settings in the Template Composer when publishing, and check the published page against this file.
category_note: Railway's category list has no 'Database' option (checked 2026-11-03); Storage is the closest available filing and is what the published page shows.
description: Single-node MongoDB 9.0 database, ready to deploy
name: MongoDB 9.0
notIncluded: Replica set / high availability / automatic failover
Backups (snapshot the volume or run mongodump on a schedule)

healthcheck.note: Database services have no HTTP healthcheck path. Health is proven by an authenticated mongosh/pymongo ping, as in scripts/local-test.sh — not by process liveness alone.

MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE.note: Optional. Set your app database name, or leave unset.

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD.note: Never ship a real value in this repo.

MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME.note: Root user created by the official image entrypoint on first start, only when /data/db is empty.

MONGO_URL.note: Railway reference variable for other services in the same project.

volumes.note: Persistent volume. Without it, data is lost on redeploy.

stillUntestedAtPublish: Live Railway deploy of this template (waits for a paid Railway plan to be active)
